description: This file implements reflog expiration and cleanup logic for a Git repository, including configuration parsing, reference handling, and commit traversal for determining which reflog entries to prune.

methods.name: find_cfg_ent
methods.description: Finds or creates a reflog expiration entry matching a pattern.

methods.name: reflog_expire_config
methods.description: Parses and applies reflog expiration configuration options.

methods.name: reflog_clear_expire_config
methods.description: Frees all reflog expiration entries and resets options.

methods.name: reflog_expire_options_set_refname
methods.description: Sets expiration times based on reference name patterns.

methods.name: tree_is_complete
methods.description: Checks if a tree object and all its entries are fully available.

methods.name: commit_is_complete
methods.description: Checks if a commit and its reachable objects are complete.

methods.name: keep_entry
methods.description: Determines if a commit object should be kept based on completeness.

methods.name: mark_reachable
methods.description: Marks commits reachable from a list, up to a certain limit.

methods.name: is_unreachable
methods.description: Checks if a commit is unreachable from current refs.

methods.name: should_expire_reflog_ent
methods.description: Decides if a reflog entry should be expired based on timestamps and reachability.

methods.name: should_expire_reflog_ent_verbose
methods.description: Verbose version of expiration check, with output.

methods.name: push_tip_to_list
methods.description: Adds the tip commit of a reference to a list.

methods.name: is_head
methods.description: Checks if a reference name is 'HEAD'.

methods.name: reflog_expiry_prepare
methods.description: Prepares reflog expiration by marking reachable commits.

methods.name: reflog_expiry_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up marked commits after expiration process.

methods.name: count_reflog_ent
methods.description: Counts reflog entries for expiration purposes.

methods.name: reflog_delete
methods.description: Deletes reflog entries based on expiration rules and configuration.
